content:
olivia (growth): Hey team — launching a short webinar + benchmark narrative next Wed. Need a small asset pack for the promo and the benchmark blog: hero image, benchmark chart graphic, 3 social card sizes, and a slide-ready summary slide. Can design own this sprint?

jared (design): @olivia yep we can. Quick Qs: which benchmark metric should be the hero chart? latency vs cost per token? also do you have the raw numbers or a mock csv? :thinking_face:

olivia (growth): Primary KPI is median p50 latency and cost/token across the three configs (hosted / dedicated / private). We want one clear bar chart comparing p50 latency and an overlay line for cost/token. I'll drop the csv now (uploading). Key message: "same API, different economics."

priyanka (content): Can we bake three narrative variants into the slide copy — PLG CTA, enterprise reliability, and cost-ops playbook? That helps reuse the same visuals for webinar vs blog vs sales. I can draft 2-3 taglines.

leo (mkt-ops): For the promo cards make sure we include the webinar registration UTM tags and size variants: 1200x628 (link), 1080x1080 (IG), 820x312 (twitter header). Also we need an alt-text line for accessibility. Who owns localization for FR/DE?

jared (design): Got it on sizes and alt. Upload looks good — thanks. @priyanka please put the 2-line taglines in the doc. For the chart I need the columns labeled exactly: "Hosted API", "Dedicated", "Private". Can you confirm the color palette? We should stick to brand palette but make the cost line a secondary accent so it reads on B/W prints.

olivia (growth): Use brand palette A (primary teal + navy). Cost line = brand-accent orange. Also need a high-contrast version for slides (WCAG). Export formats: SVG + PNG @2x + PPTX slide export. File naming: redwood_bench_[asset]_[variant]_[locale]. For example: redwood_bench_hero_desktop_en.svg

design-bot: New ticket created: MD-4582 — "Webinar benchmark asset pack" assigned to @jared. Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/bench-webinar — comments enabled.

jared (design): Plan: 1) hero + chart mock by EOD tomorrow, 2) social cards + slide template by Tues, 3) exports + localization handoff by Wed morning. Can someone confirm final approval owner?

priyanka (content): I'll own copy approval. @olivia you'll sign off on final numbers and messaging. Legal review for any claims ("cost savings") — we should route any superlatives to legal.

leo (mkt-ops): I'll set up the registration form and inbound routing. When assets are final, drop them in the shared drive with meta.json that includes utm_campaign, speaker names, and target lists. Also confirm whether webinar recording will get an evergreen landing page.

olivia (growth): Recording -> evergreen yes. Add a small conversion play: long-form replay gated for leads who attended <50% of the webinar. OK to proceed with the timeline? :thumbsup:

jared (design): 👍 starting mock now. Will post an early screenshot in this thread.

priyanka (content): Drafting three tagline options now, will paste in the figma copy tab.

olivia (growth): Thanks all — please tag this thread when you upload designs. If any blockers ping me directly. :rocket:
